title: 第19章 一剑封喉第20章 嫂子
slug: 满级武圣从绝世神功开始
content_zh:
“好一个归元派弟子……”
何雄飞没有想到，这一次居然撞到“铁板”了。
不过，这一次，何雄飞没有再退了。
因为，他已经退无可退。
江湖就是如此。
人在江湖身不由己。
一旦动手，不是你死就是我亡。
没有半分转圜的余地。
该退的时候要退。
可该拼命的时候，何雄飞也绝不会手软。
而现在，就到了该拼命的时候了！
“轰”。
何雄飞动了。
他疑似施展了秘法。
体内气血瞬间膨胀，居然打破了人体极限，气血短时间内冲破了百缕大关。
当然，这类秘法往往都有很大的代价。
不到拼命的时候，何雄飞也不会使用。
有了庞大气血的加持，何雄飞手中的重刀，直接朝着张宿一刀斩去。
这一刀，势大力沉。
远远望去，仿佛一柄巨大的“血刀”，从天而降。

再加上何雄飞天生神力，这一刀之威势，宛如雷霆万钧，任何人直面这一刀，都会感到无比恐惧。
仿佛再没有什么力量，能够抵挡这一刀。
张宿眼神中终于露出了一丝异色。
这个何雄飞，虽然只有区区百缕气血，但加上其天生神力，实力其实很强。
在归元派外门弟子之中都是佼佼者。
现在更是爆发了气血秘法，气血打破了人体极限，实力更强。
这一刀，恐怕也仅次于归元派外门十大弟子了。
难怪何雄飞能够纵横江湖，闯下偌大威名。
下一刻，张宿动了。
“咻”。
张宿脚下一动，手中的冷霜剑轻轻一划。
没什么惊天动地的气血爆发。
也没有什么诡异的招数。
看起来就仿佛普普通通的一剑。
可这一剑，却让何雄飞瞳孔一缩，心头生出了强烈的警兆。
危险！
极度危险！
这一剑，仿佛融入了空气之中，融入了烟尘之中。
依稀只能看到剑身上有一丝反光。
晃得何雄飞忍不住眯起了眼睛。

就在这一瞬。
两人错身而过。
何雄飞浑身一僵。
他那威猛无比的一刀，居然停了下来。
content_en:
"What a disciple of the Guiyuan Sect..."
He Xiongfei did not expect that he would hit an "iron plate" this time.
However, this time, He Xiongfei did not retreat.
Because he has no retreat.
This is what Jianghu is like.
People can't help themselves in the world.
Once you take action, you will die or I will die.
There is no room for change.
Retreat when it's time to retreat.
But when it's time to fight, He Xiongfei will never be soft.
And now, it's time to fight!
"boom".
He Xiong flew.
He is suspected of using a secret technique.
The qi and blood in the body expanded instantly, actually breaking the limit of the human body. The qi and blood broke through the hundred wisps mark in a short time.
Of course, such secret methods often come at a high cost.
He Xiongfei doesn't know how to use it unless he is desperate.
With the blessing of huge energy and blood, He Xiongfei slashed directly at Zhang Su with the heavy sword in his hand.
This sword is powerful and heavy.
Looking from a distance, it looks like a huge "blood knife" falling from the sky.
Coupled with He Xiongfei's natural supernatural power, the power of this sword is like thunder. Anyone who faces this sword will feel extremely frightened.
It seemed that there was no strength left that could withstand this knife.
Zhang Su finally showed a strange look in his eyes.
Although this He Xiongfei only has a hundred strands of energy and blood, coupled with his natural divine power, he is actually very powerful.
They are all outstanding among the outer disciples of Guiyuan Sect.
Now the secret method of qi and blood has exploded. The qi and blood have broken the limits of the human body and become stronger.
This sword is probably second only to the top ten disciples of the outer sect of the Guiyuan Sect.
No wonder He Xiongfei was able to travel across the rivers and lakes and achieve such great fame.
The next moment, Zhang Su moved.
"call out".
Zhang Su moved his feet and swiped the cold frost sword in his hand lightly.
There was no earth-shattering burst of energy and blood.
There are no weird tricks.
It looks like an ordinary sword.
But this sword made He Xiongfei's pupils shrink, and there was a strong warning sign in his heart.
Danger!
Extremely dangerous!
This sword seemed to blend into the air and into the smoke.
Only a faint reflection can be seen on the sword.
The shaking made He Xiongfei couldn't help but narrow his eyes.
Just at this moment.
The two passed by each other.
He Xiongfei froze.
His extremely powerful sword actually stopped.
